interpretation: Active branch copies bottom and top from RBX+0x10 and +0x14. RBX is loaded from [[R15+0x1420]]. Exact source object semantics and scaling of these values upstream remain unproven.

Helper output +0 is max(max(start depth cvar, 0) * 100000, [RCX+0xd30]) * float32(0.00001), stored to original +0xadc. The cvar name independently says StartDepth. The interpretation of [RCX+0xd30] remains unproven here.

Helper output +4 is max(trunc(depth resolution cvar),4) converted to float; +8 is its reciprocal; +0xc is max(depth cvar,1) divided by that resolution; +0x10 is its reciprocal. Copy instructions map these to original +0xae0, +0xae4, +0xae8 and +0xaec respectively.
The other branch writes float 1 to all five renamed original fields, including inverse slice length.

original_setup_radius_trace.component_vtable_and_call: Component constructor installs vtable 0x146a50e18; vtable +0x2d0 points to 0x144136a00. That function allocates 0xe8 bytes and calls 0x1446a5840 with RCX = allocation + 0x10, RDX = component. It stores the allocation into component +0x288 and passes it as RDX to scene virtual slot +0x1b8.
original_setup_radius_trace.formula: 0x1446a5852..587c copies component +0x1f0 as 32-bit bits to allocation +0x10, and stores float32(component +0x1f8 + component +0x1f0) to allocation +0x14; there is no scaling in these writes.
original_setup_radius_trace.renderer_bridge: 0x14355b9e0 saves incoming scene RCX and proxy RDX into the command at stack +0x20/+0x28; 0x143559950 receives that command, allocates a wrapper, calls 0x143558730 with RDX=proxy, then stores wrapper to scene+0x1420. 0x143558738 sets wrapper+0 to proxy. View reads [[scene+0x1420]] then proxy+0x10/+0x14. Removal path 0x14355969e..a2 selects the last remaining proxy wrapper at scene+0x1420.
original_setup_radius_trace.qualification: 0x14355b9e0 is found in original image at 0x1466f2560, consistent with a scene vtable base of 0x1466f23a8 and virtual slot +0x1b8, but this bounded capture does not independently prove that vtable is installed on the scene object reached by the component call. Thus the matching renderer bridge remains a well-supported candidate, not a complete runtime identity proof. Default values and comparison with current source support kilometre interpretation but do not independently prove original units; do not promote a units alias solely on this evidence.
